binding_semantics: A live receipt-bound LayoutSource and live Layout are mandatory. Font, viewport and receipt profiles are cross-checked. Layout.ShapeProviderFingerprint equals the source compiled dependency fingerprint; the concrete provider instance is separately bound by ProviderHash and LayoutSourceHash. The exact glyph closure is derived from placements; every trusted font-space command is independently scaled by the explicit font size and compared value-for-value with the Layout outline before trusted geometry is rasterized. Glyph selection, advances, offsets and placements remain caller-supplied and are not authenticated as ShapeProvider output; every receipt states caller-layout-unverified shaping provenance and must not be used as provider-authenticated shaping evidence.
coordinate_semantics: Trusted y-up font-space Q26.6 points are scaled once with symmetric nearest-even, then placed as x=origin_x+x and top-down y=baseline_y-y with checked int64 arithmetic. Only viewport sample centers are classified, so clipping is exact.
sampling: Every pixel has 64 equally weighted centers at Q26.6 coordinates (8*x+i)*8+4,(8*y+j)*8+4 for i,j in [0,7].
point_in_fill: Each placement is classified independently with nonzero winding and a +x ray. Crossings use lower-inclusive upper-exclusive endpoints and crossing_x strictly greater than sample_x. Filled samples from placements are unioned before coverage is counted.
curve_semantics: Line and original quadratic Bezier commands are intersected algebraically with each sample row. Quadratics are never flattened; discriminants, endpoint decisions and crossing comparisons use bounded exact integers and square-root comparisons.
composition: The union coverage count in [0,64] scales one linear-premultiplied RGBA16 paint with one nearest-even division by 64. Uncovered pixels are transparent black and glyph overlap never paints twice.
hash_semantics: CoverageHash is SHA-256 over str(coverage hash profile), u32 width, u32 height, u64 coverage length and exact row-major u8 coverage bytes. PixelHash is SHA-256 over exactly 8 bytes per pixel: raw row-major big-endian premultiplied RGBA16 channels; dimensions and its profile are bound by the receipt. BindingHash is a domain-separated fixed-width big-endian stream over the descriptor, source, provider, explicit unverified-shaping status, layout, outline, placement, coverage, paint, pixel, dimensions, font size and admitted resources, excluding only BindingHash itself.
binding_encoding: str is u64be UTF-8 byte length followed by exact bytes; u16/u32/u64 are unsigned big-endian and i64 is its two's-complement u64 bit pattern. BindingHash preimage is str(binding_hash_profile), u32be profile schema version, then these Receipt fields in order: schema_version, profile, raster_profile, descriptor_hash_profile, descriptor_hash, layout_source_profile, layout_source_hash_profile, layout_source_hash, shape_provider_profile, shape_provider_hash_profile, shape_provider_hash, dependency_fingerprint_profile, dependency_fingerprint, font_content_hash_profile, font_content_hash, shaping_provenance_status, layout_receipt_profile, layout_hash_profile, layout_hash, glyph_stream_hash_profile, glyph_stream_hash, outline_set_hash_profile, outline_set_hash, placement_hash_profile, placement_hash, binding_hash_profile, coverage_hash_profile, coverage_hash, paint_profile, kernel_profile, surface_profile, pixel_hash_profile, pixel_hash, font_size_numerator, font_size_denominator, width_pixels, height_pixels, fill_r, fill_g, fill_b, fill_a, placement_count, unique_glyph_count, contour_count, command_count, unique_segment_count, segment_count, sample_count, canonical_binary_bytes, work_units, working_bytes, retained_bytes. binding_hash itself is omitted.
resource_semantics: Let W=width, H=height, P=W*H, G=placements, U=unique glyphs, C=commands, Q=unique segments, S=placed segments, L=1+ceil(log2(8W)), K=9P+16384. CanonicalBinaryBytes is the exact sum of the CoverageHash preimage, the 8P-byte PixelHash preimage and the BindingHash preimage; pre-admission uses K. WorkUnits is (8H*S*2*(L+64)) + (64P*G) + 16C + 8S + 64P + 16P + K. WorkingBytes is 65536 + 9P + 72W + 8 + 64*(Q+S) + 96G + 128U + 48C. RetainedBytes is 8P+8192. Every operation is checked uint64 arithmetic. Limits only reject work and never select a lower quality path.
cancellation_semantics: A non-nil context is checked before validation, throughout binding, geometry, sample rows, painting and hashing, and immediately before publication. Cancellation returns a nil Surface and zero Receipt.
failure_semantics: Invalid or drifted bindings, unsupported profiles, malformed contours, overflow, exact/resource limits, allocation failure and cancellation fail closed with nil Surface and zero Receipt.
